messages.text: Hi Acme Traders, invoice INV-001 for Rs.40,000 is now 12 days overdue. Could you let us know when we can clear it?
boss month end tight, will clear 40k by Friday pakka
Understood. I can set up a one-time mandate so Rs.40,000 auto-debits Friday — no need to remember. Want that, or will you pay manually?
haan set it up, easier for me
Done — mandate registration link sent. You'll get a reminder the day before.
